problem.title: Stability Beyond Unstable Population-Process Fluid Limits
problem.statement: In the two-chunk deterministic-first-chunk peer-to-peer population process, the large-system-limit dynamical system is unstable while simulations suggest that the stochastic process is stable. Prove or disprove this stability conjecture, and hence determine whether instability of a population process can fail to follow from instability of its large-system limit.

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The report presents stability of the stochastic Deterministic First Chunk system as a simulation-supported conjecture. Later work proves instability of its large-system limit, but does not settle the stochastic claim in this record.

**Sources checked.**

- [Norros Reittu and Eirola stability paper](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11134-011-9209-2)
- [original problem report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2010/48)
